profile.headline: Senior Deep Learning Software Engineer at NVIDIA
profile.summary:
Interested in deep learning, compilers, optimization, computer graphics, and GPU acceleration.

My passion for engineering began when I was 13 and I taught myself C++ so that I could make my own video games. I got my BS and MS at UCSB while researching deep learning applications in image processing and rendering. Since then, I have worked at multiple companies which are leaders in AI/ML. My work has focused on deep learning performance optimization, especially for GPUs.

positions.title: Senior Deep Learning Software Engineer
positions.description:
DL Frameworks - Sglang
Previously XLA, Jax and Tensorflow.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
SDE on AWS SageMaker Neo, a compilation service for deep learning models. Neo uses Apache TVM, an open source deep learning compiler project, to optimize models from any framework for a variety of hardware targets from cloud to edge.

Integrated TVM with NVIDIA TensorRT to improve performance across all supported frameworks and model zoos by 2x to 10x on cloud GPU instances and NVIDIA edge devices such as Jetson Xavier, TX1, TX2, and Nano. My integration uses a hybrid approach which leverages the strengths of both TVM and TensorRT by using TensorRT for certain parts of the model and TVM for others, resulting in greater performance than TVM or TensorRT alone.

positions.title: Deep Learning Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed over 50 PRs to TensorFlow in order to integrate it with TensorRT for faster inference on GPUs (TF-TRT). My contributions more than doubled the number of TensorFlow Ops supported and enabled accelerated inference for object detection and language models.

Implemented a feature to optimize and deploy neural networks trained via quantization-aware training to achieve improved performance of 8-bit integer precision without harming accuracy.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States
positions.description:
The MIRAGE Lab at UCSB solves problems in computer graphics, rendering, and image processing.

My research project was applying deep learning to generate and recover detailed images from low resolution input images (super-resolution) using generative adversarial networks (GANs).

I also worked with several PhD students on their research projects, which mostly involved using deep learning to accelerate rendering of photorealistic images. My contributions involved modifying Blender's rendering engine Cycles to integrate with TensorFlow, importance sample from light spheres, and output features which are used for training deep learning algorithms.

positions.title: Deep Learning R&D Intern
positions.description:
During this internship, I worked on a project for the TSA where I researched  and applied the use of deep convolutional neural networks to detect and classify threats in X-Ray security images, achieving an AUROC of 0.95.

Our general approach was to fine tune state-of-the-art CNN architectures that had been pretrained on natural images (ImageNet). I also implemented an interesting algorithm to visualize where a threat is located within a given x-ray scan, providing insight into how well our models had generalized.

I presented our work at the 2017 Sandia Machine Learning and Deep Learning Conference, and my mentor presented our work at the TSA Headquarters at the 2017 TSA Deep Learning Technical Interchange. Our paper was accepted to ICMLA 2018.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
During this internship I developed a web application using Ruby on Rails for the Technical Reachback project, which is focused on providing services to CBP and law enforcement in order to prevent proliferation of radioactive threats.

Implemented a search feature by integrating the app with Apache Solr within my first 2 weeks.
Redesigned entire frontend using the Bootstrap framework which greatly improved aesthetics and allowed the site to function on all screen resolutions.
Integrated with the openFDA API and designed an interface utilizing JS, jQuery and AJAX to allow admins to easily evaluate and accept updates to our database.
Working as a full-time summer intern and part-time year-round intern.

honors.title: 2nd Place, UCSB Computer Science Senior Capstone Project
honors.description: Our team won the 2nd place prize with our project NovaTooth - a bluetooth penetration testing and surveillance platform in partnership with Novacoast
honors.issuer: Issued by UCSB Department of Computer Science · Mar 2017

projects.title: Realtime Photorealistic Pathtracing with Neural Network Denoising
projects.description: Developed an efficient GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo path tracer using CUDA and integrated it with a denoising neural network trained in PyTorch to render photorealistic images at 60 frames per second.

projects.title: Implementation of Mara et al: Fast Global Illumination Approximations on Deep G-Buffers
projects.description: Utilized multilayered G-buffers (rendered in a single pass) to approximate global illumination lighting effects in real time.

publications.title: Convolutional Neural Networks for Automatic Threat Detection in Security X-ray Images
publications.publisher: IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning Applications · Jan 1, 2018
